events.text: A hardened inmate approaches you in the yard and asks whether you want protection — at a price.

choices.label: Join the group
choices.resultText: You gained protection but made enemies of rivals.

choices.label: Politely refuse
choices.resultText: They backed off — for now.

choices.label: Report it to a guard
choices.resultText: The warden noted your cooperation.

events.text: Guards announce a surprise cell search. You notice something questionable tucked under a bunk nearby.

choices.label: Stay silent
choices.resultText: The search passed without incident — this time.

choices.label: Speak up honestly
choices.resultText: The guards thanked you for cooperating.

choices.label: Hide contraband for a cellmate
choices.resultText: You were caught holding the goods.

events.text: The prison librarian offers you a quiet shift sorting books and tutoring inmates who want to read.

choices.label: Volunteer for library duty
choices.resultText: The warden noted your good behavior.

choices.label: Decline and rest
choices.resultText: You spent the afternoon on your bunk.

events.text: Tension boils over in the yard and someone shoves you during an argument over food rations.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.resultText: You kept your record clean.

choices.label: Fight back
choices.resultText: Both of you landed in solitary.

choices.label: Call for a guard
choices.resultText: Order was restored quickly.

events.text: A family member travels a long distance to visit you through the glass partition.

choices.label: Promise to do better
choices.resultText: Their eyes welled up with hope.

choices.label: Stay guarded and quiet
choices.resultText: The visit was awkward but meaningful.

events.text: You write a long letter home from prison.

choices.label: Send it
choices.resultText: It helped you feel connected.

choices.label: Tear it up
choices.resultText: Some feelings are hard to share.

events.text: A new arrival looks lost at mealtime. Older inmates are already watching who sits where.

choices.label: Make space at your table
choices.resultText: You gain a cautious ally. The room notices you did not pick on the weak.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.resultText: You eat in peace. The new arrival finds another way, or does not.

choices.label: Join the mockery
choices.resultText: Cheap laughs. Staff write it down anyway.

events.text: The library cart stops at your block. Most books are falling apart. One title still looks unread.

choices.label: Take the book and actually finish it
choices.resultText: The story lasts longer than the day. A counsellor later asks what you thought.

choices.label: Trade it for extra snacks
choices.resultText: Calories now. The pages go to someone else.

choices.label: Ignore the cart
choices.resultText: Another afternoon of staring at paint.

events.text: Yard time. A pickup game starts, then a foul turns into shoving.

choices.label: Break it up before officers arrive
choices.resultText: Nobody thanks you loudly. The count stays clean.

choices.label: Back your side and swing
choices.resultText: Adrenaline, bruises, and a write-up.

choices.label: Walk the fence until it ends
choices.resultText: Coward to some. Free to others. You still have yard tomorrow.

events.text: A job supervisor offers you kitchen duty — early mornings, extra food, and closer eyes on you.

choices.label: Take the kitchen job
choices.resultText: Burnt wrists and better meals. You look employable on paper.

choices.label: Stay on laundry and keep your head down
choices.resultText: Predictable. Safe. The days blur.

choices.label: Refuse work and sleep in
choices.resultText: Idle time is not rest here. Staff mark you uncooperative.

events.text: Lights-out is late because of a count discrepancy. Everyone is tired and rumour fills the dark.

choices.label: Tell people to stay quiet
choices.resultText: The block settles. Officers finish faster.

choices.label: Start a whispered card game
choices.resultText: You win a few extra commissary IOUs. Someone still snores through it.

choices.label: Lie awake and replay your case
choices.resultText: No new answers. Dawn still arrives.

events.text: A counsellor schedules a short session. They ask if you have a plan for the first month after release.

choices.label: Talk honestly about work and housing
choices.resultText: They write something useful in your file. It feels like a door, not a lecture.

choices.label: Give the answers they want to hear
choices.resultText: The session is smooth and empty. Paperwork likes you anyway.

choices.label: Shut down and stare at the clock
choices.resultText: They mark you as unengaged. The hour still counts against you.

events.text: A package from outside is delayed. Someone offers to 'speed it up' for a favour.

choices.label: Wait for official channels
choices.resultText: It arrives late and intact. You keep your record clean.

choices.label: Pay the favour
choices.resultText: You get your things. You also owe a person you should not owe.

choices.label: Report the offer
choices.resultText: Staff listen. The wing gets colder toward you for a week.
